retrieval: Parent used existing authorized logged-in browser session and downloaded the manufacturer-posted STEP. No vendor contact or server join.
ER11_applicability: Manufacturer FAQ states ER11, ER16 and ER20 share the external geometry, with sockets differing. The downloaded source is already 60mm wide; it was not scaled from an older54mm model.
limits: Dated manufacturer installation housing, not inspection of the currently delivered kit
Internal ER11 socket mechanisms, moving nut engagement plane, actual IR optics/cable exits are absent
Received kit revision must match this installation pattern before machining supplier-specific faces

export_placement.method: Original local solid with explicit cq.Assembly.add loc; do not bake translation of original topcap before STEP serialization
export_placement.reason: The original local topcap passes BRep validity, but baking a ~1m translation then exporting makes its small corner trim wire self-intersect on readback. Keeping the local definition and using an assembly placement preserves valid unmodified geometry.
